extDescription.message: Translate selected text in a small bubble, with a local LLM or your own OpenRouter key.

errorNotConfigured.message: Choose where translations come from to start translating.

errorTooLong.message: The selection is too long. Glossator translates up to $LIMIT$ characters at a time.

errorUnauthorized.message: The API key was rejected. Check it in Settings.

errorInsufficientCredits.message: Your OpenRouter account has run out of credits.

errorModeration.message: OpenRouter declined to translate this text.

errorOriginRejected.message: The local server refused the request. See Troubleshooting in the README (OLLAMA_ORIGINS).

errorModelNotFound.message: This server does not have the selected model. Pull it first or pick another one in Settings.

errorTimeout.message: The server took too long to answer.

errorRateLimited.message: Too many requests right now. Wait a moment and retry.

errorUnavailable.message: The model is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

errorUnreachable.message: Cannot reach the server. Is it running?

actionTryCloud.message: Try via OpenRouter (sends the text to the cloud)

popupFallback.message: If it is already in that language, into

onboardingIntro.message: Glossator has no server of its own. Pick a place to send selected text to; you can add the other one later.

onboardingLocalBody.message: Text never leaves your computer. Needs Ollama, LM Studio or a similar server running a translation model.

onboardingCloudBody.message: Paste an OpenRouter API key and start. Text goes through OpenRouter to the model's host, with no-retention routing on by default.

sectionProviderHint.message: Glossator only uses the provider selected here. It never switches to the cloud on its own.

cloudKeyHint.message: Stored only in this browser profile. Create one at openrouter.ai/keys.

cloudKeyOkUnlimited.message: Key works. No spending limit set.

cloudModelCustomHint.message: Any model ID from openrouter.ai/models. You choose where your text goes.

cloudStrictPrivacyHint.message: Only route to hosts that neither store nor train on your text. Some models become unavailable.

modelNoteGemma.message: open weights, independent hosts, more languages

localHint.message: Any server with an OpenAI-compatible API. Local and private-network addresses count as Local; anything else is shown as Self-hosted.

localTestMissing.message: Connected, but this model is missing. For Ollama run: ollama pull $MODEL$

presetLmStudioHint.message: Start the server in LM Studio's Developer tab or with lms server start. CORS is not needed; leave it off so websites cannot use your model.

presetLlamaCppHint.message: Start llama-server with the model you want to use.

presetCustomHint.message: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as vLLM.

languagesFallback.message: If the text is already in that language, translate into

languagesUnsupported.message: The current model does not support $LANGUAGE$.

surroundingContextHint.message: Sends the paragraph around the selection too, which helps with ambiguous words. Off by default because it sends more of the page.

selectionIconToggle.message: Show a translate icon next to selected text on every page

selectionIconHint.message: A small icon next to selected text opens the translation. Without it, use the right-click menu or the keyboard shortcut.

shortcutHint.message: Suggested: Alt+Shift+T (Option+Shift+T on a Mac). You can change it on the browser's extension shortcuts page.

shortcutMissing.message: No shortcut is set. The browser leaves it empty when another extension already uses the same keys. Pick one on the shortcuts page.

styleHint.message: Tells the model how the translation should sound.

styleCustomPlaceholder.message: e.g. short and plain, like a chat message

glossaryHint.message: Terms that must always be translated the same way. Each pair works in both directions, and only terms found in the selected text are sent to the model.

glossaryFull.message: The glossary is full. Remove terms to add new ones.

extrasUnsupported.message: The current model (TranslateGemma) ignores the glossary and style.
